  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2))
  (x : Fin 2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), ![x (e 0), x (e 1)] ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm e) = x
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedKinds.perm_symm_vec : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2))
  (x : Fin 2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), ![x (e 0), x (e 1)] ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm e) = x :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] e x =>
  funext fun i =>
    Exists.casesOn (Equiv.surjective e i) fun j h =>
      h ▸
        Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congrArg ![x (e 0), x (e 1)] (Equiv.symm_apply_apply e j))) (x (e j))))
          (match j with
          | 0 => Eq.refl (![x (e 0), x (e 1)] 0)
          | 1 => Eq.refl (![x (e 0), x (e 1)] 1))

  {

      Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun γ h =>
          Exists.intro a

                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => x ∈ D ↔ _a)

      Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun γ h =>
          Exists.intro a

                {
                  mp := fun a_1 =>
                    Exists.casesOn a_1 fun x h_1 =>
                      And.casesOn h_1 fun hx right =>
                        right ▸ (DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode_mem_iff_value a x γ).mpr ((h x).mp hx),

                    have hz' :=
                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.disc_underlying_subset_vf (DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode a γ) hz;
                    Exists.intro ⟨z, hz'⟩
                      ⟨(h ⟨z, hz'⟩).mpr ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode_mem_iff_value a ⟨z, hz'⟩ γ).mp hz),

                  this))

            (h x).mpr
              (have h2 := SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_min_le_sub (x - a') (a - a');
              have h1' :=
                Eq.mpr
                  (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑γ < _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.vfValue_sub_swap a a')))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a * ↑ρ < ↑σ * w) (mul_inv_cancel₀ hσ))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)} {x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},

  {

      Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
        Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 => x_1 ∈ A ∧ x_1.swap = (y, x) → (x, y) ∈ A) w

  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A ε t₁ t₂ →
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced (Prod.swap '' A)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε) t₂ t₁
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.balanced_transpose : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A ε t₁ t₂ →
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced (Prod.swap '' A)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε) t₂ t₁ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {A} {ε}
    {t₁ t₂} h =>
  And.casesOn h.rvAffine fun hA₁ right =>
    And.casesOn right fun left right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun s hs =>
        {
          first_disc :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.IsOpenDiscVF _a)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.first_swap A)))
              h.second_disc,
          second_disc :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.IsOpenDiscVF _a)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.second_swap A)))
              h.first_disc,
          bijective :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    Set.BijOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε) _a
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second (Prod.swap '' A)))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.first_swap A)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      Set.BijOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second A) _a)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.second_swap A)))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.positionInv_bijOn h)),
          discToDisc :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.DiscToDisc _a
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.first_swap A)))
              fun E hEA hE =>
              Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.isOpenDiscVF_iff.mp hE) fun c h_1 =>
                Exists.casesOn h_1 fun ρ hc =>
                  have hcE :=
                    (hc c).mpr
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ρ < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a) (sub_self c)))
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.gamma_lt_value_zero ρ));
                  have hcA := hEA hcE;
                  let a := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε c;

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.jacobian_rv_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  {X : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 q) S}
  {ε : (Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}
  {t : (Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M}
  {t₁ : (Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M}
  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.BalancedShearInput X ε t t₁)
  (a : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.firstFamily X).carrier) {J : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.positionMap H).toFun a
      J →
    ∀ {s : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M},
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.HasSlope
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.cell X (↑a).2))
          (ε (↑a).2) s →
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M J = ↑s :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {q}
    {X} {ε} {t} {t₁} H a {J} hJ {s} hs =>
  Exists.casesOn hJ fun F h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hF right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun A h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hpart hdet =>
          have hJ0 :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A 0 0 = _a) (Eq.symm hdet)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A 0 0 = _a) (Matrix.det_fin_one A))) (Eq.refl (A 0 0)));
          have hp := hpart 0 0;
          have hcenter := SpecialTransformations.Section9.IsVFChartAt.center hF;
          Exists.casesOn hF fun ρ hρ =>
            let σ := DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.rvRadius s;
            Exists.casesOn
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFPartialAt F (↑a).1 0 0 _a) hJ0) hp σ)
              fun δ hδ =>
              Exists.casesOn (exists_gt (max δ ρ)) fun γ hγ =>
                Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section8.gamma_has_vf_representative γ) fun r h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hr hval =>
                    have hrδ :=
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑δ < _a) hval))
                        (LE.le.trans_lt
                          (have this := le_max_left δ ρ;
                          this)
                          hγ);
                    let a₁ := (↑a).1;
                    let x := a₁ + Pi.single 0 r;
                    have hx := fun i =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a => ↑ρ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x _a - (↑a).1 _a))
                            (Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i)))
                        (id
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  ↑ρ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom ((↑a).1 0 + _a - (↑a).1 0))
                                (Pi.single_eq_same 0 r)))
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ρ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                                  (add_sub_cancel_left ((↑a).1 0) r)))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ρ < _a) hval))
                                (LE.le.trans_lt
                                  (have this := le_max_right δ ρ;
                                  this)
                                  hγ)))));
                    Exists.casesOn (hρ x hx) fun hxA hFx =>
                      have hFx0 := Eq.symm (congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst hFx) 0);
                      have hFa0 := congrFun hcenter 0;
                      have hx0 :=
                        id

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {q : ℕ} (f : Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M)
  (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ν : Fin 2 → Fin q) (l : Fin 0 → Fin q),
  ∏ i, f (Fin.append (fun i => ν ((Equiv.symm σ) i)) l i) = f (ν 0) * f (ν 1) :=

      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = f (ν 0) * f (ν 1))
        (Fin.prod_univ_add fun i => f (Fin.append (fun i => ν ((Equiv.symm σ) i)) l i))))

        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq

            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.mem_translationTarget_iff hv H R ↑z).mp z.property)

              have hx := congrArg Prod.fst hz;
              have hw := congrArg Prod.snd hz;

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece : ∀ {M : Type} {n m : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → M) → Fin m → M}
  {A P Q : Set (Fin n → M)} {C : Set (Fin m → M)},
  Set.BijOn f A C → A = P ∪ Q → Disjoint P Q → C \ f '' (A ∩ Q) = f '' (A ∩ P)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece : ∀ {M : Type} {n m : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → M) → Fin m → M}
  {A P Q : Set (Fin n → M)} {C : Set (Fin m → M)},
  Set.BijOn f A C → A = P ∪ Q → Disjoint P Q → C \ f '' (A ∩ Q) = f '' (A ∩ P) :=
fun {M} {n m} {f} {A P Q} {C} hf hA hPQ =>
  Set.ext fun y =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hy hnot =>
          Exists.casesOn (hf.right.right hy) fun x h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y => y ∈ C → y ∉ f '' (A ∩ Q) → y ∈ f '' (A ∩ P))
                (fun hy hnot =>
                  have hx' := hA ▸ hx;
                  Or.casesOn hx' (fun hp => Exists.intro x ⟨⟨hx, hp⟩, rfl⟩) fun hq =>
                    absurd (Exists.intro x ⟨⟨hx, hq⟩, rfl⟩) hnot)
                right hy hnot,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left right =>
            And.casesOn left fun hx hp =>
              right ▸
                ⟨hf.left hx, fun a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun x' h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun left he =>
                      And.casesOn left fun hx' hq =>
                        have hxx := hf.right.left hx' hx he;
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x ∈ A → x ∈ P → f x' = f x → False)
                          (fun hx hp he => Set.disjoint_left.mp hPQ hp hq) hxx hx hp he⟩ }
'DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prepared_slice_covariant : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    ∀ {S : Set M} {n : ℕ} {e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
      {A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject S (n + 1 + 1)}
      (F₀ : DiamondIntegral.Section6.NormalizedMeasuredContraction A.carrier A.form e)
      (b : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
      (t : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + A.labels) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
      ∃ α,
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.NamedRadii S t α ∧
          ∀ (x y : Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
            (hx :
              (Fin.snoc b (x 0), t) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet F₀.normalization.map.image e).carrier)
            (hy :
              (Fin.snoc b (y 0), t) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet F₀.normalization.map.image e).carrier),

              DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue F₀.preparedForm ⟨(Fin.snoc b (x 0), t), hx⟩ =
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue F₀.preparedForm ⟨(Fin.snoc b (y 0), t), hy⟩ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 {S} {n} {e} {A} F₀ b t =>
  let D := F₀.normalization;
  let u := fun j => t (Fin.natAdd (n + 1 + 1) j);
  Exists.casesOn (A.formCovariant u) fun α h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hα hcov =>
      Exists.intro (fun x => α (e (Fin.last (n + 1))))
        ⟨fun x =>
          Set.Definable.mono (hα (e (Fin.last (n + 1)))) fun ⦃z⦄ a =>
            Or.casesOn a (fun hz => Or.inl hz) fun h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun j h => h ▸ Or.inr (Exists.intro (Fin.natAdd (n + 1 + 1) j) rfl),
          fun x y hx hy hxy =>
          have hb := DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prep_bijective h00 F₀;
          Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hb ⟨(Fin.snoc b (x 0), t), hx⟩) fun px hpx =>
            Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hb ⟨(Fin.snoc b (y 0), t), hy⟩) fun py hpy =>
              have hvx :=
                Eq.trans (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prep_value F₀ px))
                  (congrArg Subtype.val hpx);
              have hvy :=
                Eq.trans (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prep_value F₀ py))
                  (congrArg Subtype.val hpy);
              have htx := congrArg Prod.snd hvx;
              have hty := congrArg Prod.snd hvy;
              have hux :=
                funext fun j =>
                  have h := congrFun htx (Fin.natAdd (n + 1 + 1) j);
                  Eq.mp
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (↑px) i)) (↑px).2 j))

                          (congrArg Eq

                        (Eq.mp
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq

                                i))
                            (t (Fin.castAdd A.labels i)))
                          h2)));
              have hfx := congrArg Prod.fst hvx;
              have hfy := congrArg Prod.fst hvy;
              have hcoord := fun k =>
                have h1 := congrFun hfx ((Equiv.symm e) k);
                have h2 := congrFun hfy ((Equiv.symm e) k);

  Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear 1)
    ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_derivative hv X 1 hX p,
      have h :=
        LinearMap.ext fun x =>
          funext fun i =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a i = LinearMap.id x i) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear_apply 1 x)))

        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.det = 1) LinearMap.toMatrix'_id))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) Matrix.det_one)) (Eq.refl 1)))⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Corollary715.proj_of_relativelyUnary : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ} {e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
  {A' A'' : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject S (n + 1 + 1)}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.Morphism G A' A''),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFRelativelyUnary F.map (e (Fin.last (n + 1))) (e (Fin.last (n + 1))) →
    ∀ (b : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      (∃ p ∈ A'.carrier.carrier, ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), b j = p.1 (e j.castSucc)) ↔
        ∃ p ∈ A''.carrier.carrier, ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), b j = p.1 (e j.castSucc) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {n} {e} {A' A''} F hF b =>
  have hfix := fun p j =>
    have hne := fun h => Fin.castSucc_ne_last j (Equiv.injective e h);
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑p).1 (e j.castSucc)) (hF p (e j.castSucc) hne)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => (↑p).1 _a = (↑p).1 (e j.castSucc))
            (Equiv.symm_apply_apply (e (Fin.last (n + 1))).cycleRange (e j.castSucc))))
        (Eq.refl ((↑p).1 (e j.castSucc))));
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp hb =>
          Exists.intro ↑(F.map.toFun ⟨p, hp⟩)
            ⟨(F.map.toFun ⟨p, hp⟩).property, fun j => Eq.trans (hb j) (Eq.symm (hfix ⟨p, hp⟩ j))⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun q h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hq hb =>
          Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective F.bijective ⟨q, hq⟩) fun p hp =>
            Exists.intro ↑p
              ⟨p.property, fun j =>
                Eq.trans (hb j)
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => q.1 (e j.castSucc) = _a) (Eq.symm (hfix p j))))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => q.1 (e j.castSucc) = (↑_a).1 (e j.castSucc)) hp))
                      (Eq.refl (q.1 (e j.castSucc)))))⟩ }

  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {k : ℕ}

  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ↔
    w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
          (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {k : ℕ}
  (r : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart B k) (τ : DiamondIntegral.Section4.AnnularBlowup.Aperture r)
  (w : Fin (1 + (1 + r.arity)) → M),
  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ↔
    w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
          (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧
        1 <
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
              (w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx r)) ∧
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx r)) ≤
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
              ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {k}
    r τ w =>
  have h :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.VariableApertureRayCancellation.annularChart_join_iff
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ) (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graph_aperture_nonzero r τ)
      (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
      (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity));
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg
      (fun _a =>
        _a ∈
            (DiamondIntegral.Section4.VariableApertureRayCancellation.annularChart
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)).domain ↔
          w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
                (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧
              1 <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) 0) ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) 0) ≤
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)))
      (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_reconstruct 1 (1 + r.arity) w;
      this))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  (I : Set (Fin r.arity → M))
  (hI :
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) I),
  DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI) =
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ∩ DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {k}
    r τ I hI =>
  Set.ext fun w =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            w ∈
                DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI) ↔
              _a)
          (propext
            (Set.mem_inter_iff w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I)))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔
                w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ∧
                  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I)
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI) w))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                w ∘
                        DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1
                          (1 + (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI).arity) ∈
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI)).domain ∧
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
                        (w ∘
                          DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1
                            (1 + (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI).arity)) ∧
                      1 <
                          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                            (w
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI))) ∧
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                            (w
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI))) ≤
                          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                            ((w ∘
                                DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1
                                  (1 + (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI).arity))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI))) ↔
                  _a ∧ w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I)
              (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff r τ w))))
          {
            mp := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left right =>
                And.casesOn left fun left he =>
                  And.casesOn left fun hd hi =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hp right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun h1 h2 =>
                        have hw :=
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff r τ w).mpr ⟨⟨hd, he⟩, ⟨hp, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩;
                        ⟨⟨⟨hd, he⟩, ⟨hp, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩,
                          ⟨hi, DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_sorted r τ hw⟩⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left right =>
                And.casesOn left fun left right_1 =>
                  And.casesOn left fun hd he =>
                    And.casesOn right_1 fun hp right_2 =>
                      And.casesOn right_2 fun h1 h2 =>
                        And.casesOn right fun hi right => ⟨⟨⟨hd, hi⟩, he⟩, ⟨hp, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩ }))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryComparison.cancel_gamma.{u_1} : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G]
  (a t s : G), a * t * (s * t⁻¹) = a * s :=
fun {G} [CommGroup G] a t s =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => a * t * _a = a * s) (mul_comm s t⁻¹)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = a * s) (Eq.symm (mul_assoc (a * t) t⁻¹ s))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * s = a * s) (mul_assoc a t t⁻¹)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => a * _a * s = a * s) (mul_inv_cancel t)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * s = a * s) (mul_one a))) (Eq.refl (a * s))))))

      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>

    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.cls_eq_iff.mpr
      (let Xa := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreObjects.fibreObject T A ω a π hFa hNZ;
      let Xb := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreObjects.fibreObject T A ω b π hFb hNZ;

                            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreComparison.fibreObject_domain A ω a π hFa hNZ u).mp hu)),

                            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreComparison.fibreObject_domain A ω b π hFb hNZ u).mp hu)),

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreInvariance.pow_injective_of_one_lt : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {c : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  c ≠ 0 → 1 < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c → Function.Injective fun k => c ^ (k + 1) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {c} hc0
    h1 =>
  have key := fun j k hjk he =>
    have hsplit :=
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => c ^ (k + 1) = _a) (Eq.symm (pow_add c (j + 1) (k - j)))))
        ((fun {α β γ} [HPow α β γ] a a_1 e_a =>
            Eq.rec (motive := fun a_2 e_a => ∀ (a_3 a_4 : β), a_3 = a_4 → a ^ a_3 = a_2 ^ a_4)
              (fun a_2 a_3 e_a => e_a ▸ Eq.refl (a ^ a_2)) e_a)
          c c (Eq.refl c) (k + 1) (j + 1 + (k - j))
          (Decidable.byContradiction fun a =>
            DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreInvariance.pow_injective_of_one_lt._proof_1_1 j k hjk a));
    have hone :=
      have h0 := pow_ne_zero (j + 1) hc0;
      have this :=
        mul_left_cancel₀ h0
          (Eq.trans (Eq.symm (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => c ^ (j + 1) = _a) hsplit) he))
            (Eq.symm (mul_one (c ^ (j + 1)))));
      this;
    have hv1 :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreInvariance.vfValue_pow c (k - j)))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a = 1) hone))
          (id (map_one SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)));
    have hle :=
      le_self_pow (LT.lt.le h1) fun a =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreInvariance.pow_injective_of_one_lt._proof_1_2 j k hjk a;
    absurd h1 (not_lt.mpr (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue c ≤ _a) hv1) hle));
  fun ⦃j k⦄ he =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun hne =>
    Or.casesOn (Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne) (fun h => key j k h he) fun h => key k j h (Eq.symm he)

    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc hv linear {κ} hκ hs {S} hsmall
    hΓ {n r} {Y} {θ} D =>
  let H := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.headStage D.program;
  let V₁ := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restLift h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ D;
  let τ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvProjection V₁.map;
  have hτ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant.rvProjection V₁.map V₁.home.covariant;
  have hGr :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv τ
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contracted_proper H) hτ;
  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.properInvariant_uniform_named_radius h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hGr)
    fun δ h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hδdef right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hδ1 hInv =>
        Exists.intro δ
          ⟨hδdef,
            ⟨hδ1, fun a b hab u ha =>
              let p := ⟨(a, u), ha⟩;
              have hmem := Exists.intro p rfl;
              have hmem' := (hInv (Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2) a b hab).mp hmem;
              Exists.casesOn hmem' fun p' hp' =>
                have hp'v := hp';
                have h1 :=
                  congrArg Prod.fst
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p'))
                      hp'v);
                have h2 :=
                  funext fun i =>

                      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (↑p').2 (↑(τ.toFun p')).2 i))
                        (Fin.append_left u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i))

                        (congrArg Prod.snd
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p'))

                  funext fun i =>
                    Eq.mp
                      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (↑p').2 (↑(τ.toFun p')).2 i))
                        (Fin.append_right u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i))
                      (congrFun
                        (congrArg Prod.snd
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p'))
                            hp'v))
                        (Fin.natAdd (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.headStage D.program).arity i));
                have hb :=
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, u) ∈ H.contracted.carrier) (Eq.symm h1)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p').1, _a) ∈ H.contracted.carrier) (Eq.symm h2))) p'.property);
                Exists.intro hb
                  (have hpp := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h1 h2);
                  have hmap :=
                    Subtype.ext
                      (Prod.ext (funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i)

                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>

                              (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(V₁.map.toFun ⟨(b, u), hb⟩)).2 = _a) (Eq.symm (V₁.labels p))))
                              (Eq.mpr
                                (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(V₁.map.toFun _a)).2 = (↑(V₁.map.toFun p)).2) (Eq.symm hpp)))
                                (id h3))))));

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {m : ℕ} {b : Fin m → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}
  {a : Fin (m + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}, Fin.init a = b → a = Fin.snoc b (a (Fin.last m))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {m : ℕ} {b : Fin m → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}

      ((fun a a_1 e_a =>
          Eq.rec (motive := fun a_2 e_a =>
            ∀ (a_3 : Fin (m + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), (a = a_3) = (a_2 = a_3))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.isAlgebraic_of_finSucc_root : ∀ {m : ℕ} {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F]
  {K L : Subfield F},

      (∀ (j : Fin m), b j ∈ L) →

          MvPolynomial.eval₂ K.subtype b R.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.isAlgebraic_of_finSucc_root.{u_1} : ∀ {m : ℕ} {F : Type u_1}
  [inst : Field F] {K L : Subfield F},
  K ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : Fin m → F),
      (∀ (j : Fin m), b j ∈ L) →
        ∀ (R : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin m) ↥K)),
          MvPolynomial.eval₂ K.subtype b R.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 →
            ∀ (x : F), Polynomial.eval₂ (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) x R = 0 → IsAlgebraic (↥L) x :=
fun {m} {F} [Field F] {K L} hKL b hb R hlead x hx =>
  let bL := fun j => ⟨b j, hb j⟩;
  let φ := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Subfield.inclusion hKL) bL;
  have hφR :=
    MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      (fun a =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congr (congrArg Eq (congrArg (⇑L.subtype) (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C (Subfield.inclusion hKL) bL a)))
              (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C K.subtype b a)))
          (Eq.refl (L.subtype ((Subfield.inclusion hKL) a))))
      fun i =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congr (congrArg Eq (congrArg (⇑L.subtype) (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' (Subfield.inclusion hKL) bL i)))
            (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' K.subtype b i)))
        (Eq.refl (L.subtype (bL i)));
  Exists.intro (Polynomial.map φ R)
    ⟨fun h0 =>
      hlead
        (have h1 :=
          have h := Polynomial.coeff_map φ R.natDegree;
          Eq.symm
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = φ (R.coeff R.natDegree)) (Polynomial.coeff_zero R.natDegree))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a.coeff R.natDegree = φ (R.coeff R.natDegree)) h0) h));
        have h2 := RingHom.congr_fun hφR R.leadingCoeff;
        Eq.symm
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) R.leadingCoeff) (map_zero L.subtype))
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => L.subtype _a = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) R.leadingCoeff) h1)
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) R.leadingCoeff)
                  (RingHom.comp_apply L.subtype φ R.leadingCoeff))
                h2)))),
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Polynomial.aeval_def x (Polynomial.map φ R))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Polynomial.eval₂_map φ (algebraMap (↥L) F) x)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Polynomial.eval₂ (_a.comp φ) x R = 0) (Subfield.algebraMap_ofSubfield L)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Polynomial.eval₂ _a x R = 0) hφR)) hx)))⟩

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.GoodPoints.exists_grid_nonzero : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [Finite σ] [inst : Field F]
  (P : MvPolynomial σ F),
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a : σ → F) (C : Finset F), P.totalDegree < C.card → ∃ y, (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.GoodPoints.exists_grid_nonzero.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [Finite σ]
  [inst : Field F] (P : MvPolynomial σ F),
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a : σ → F) (C : Finset F),
      P.totalDegree < C.card → ∃ y, (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0 :=
fun {σ} {F} [Finite σ] [Field F] P hP a C hC =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
    hP
      (MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_zero_at_prod_finset P (fun i => Finset.image (fun c => a i + c) C)
        (fun i =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => MvPolynomial.degreeOf i P < _a)
                (Finset.card_image_of_injective C (add_right_injective (a i)))))
            (lt_of_le_of_lt (MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree P i) hC))
        fun x hx =>
        have hy := fun i =>
          Exists.casesOn (Finset.mem_image.mp (hx i)) fun c h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hc hce =>
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a - a i ∈ C) (Eq.symm hce)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ C) (add_sub_cancel_left (a i) c))) hc);
        have h' :=
          Eq.mp
            (Eq.trans
              (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun y => (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0)
              (forall_congr fun y =>
                Eq.trans (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_and_eq (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ((MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0))
                  (implies_congr (Eq.refl (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C)) Classical.not_not._simp_2)))
            h (fun i => x i - a i) hy;
        have hxa :=
          funext fun i =>
            of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (add_sub_cancel (a i) (x i))) (x i)) (eq_self (x i)));
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (MvPolynomial.eval _a) P = 0) hxa) h')

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.GoodPoints.exists_grid_nonzero_subfield : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [Finite σ]

  [Finite σ] [inst : Field F] (K : Subfield F) (P : MvPolynomial σ ↥K),
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a : σ → F) (C : Finset F),
      P.totalDegree < C.card → ∃ y, (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ MvPolynomial.eval₂ K.subtype (a + y) P ≠ 0 :=

  have hinj := MvPolynomial.map_injective K.subtype (Subfield.subtype_injective K);

    hP

          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => 0 = _a) (map_zero (MvPolynomial.map K.subtype)))) (Eq.refl 0))));
  have hdeg :=
    have he :=
      id

      Exists.intro y
        ⟨hy, Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ≠ 0) (MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map K.subtype (a + y) P))) hne⟩

          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma722Objects.normForm h00 A' D).toFun z :=

    fun p₀ h =>
    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun p =>
      (↑p).2 = (↑z).2 →
        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma722Objects.normForm h00 A' D).toFun p =
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma722Objects.normForm h00 A' D).toFun z)
      (fun he =>
        Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.bijective D h00) z)
          fun z₀ h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun z =>
            (↑(D.bijection.toFun p₀)).2 = (↑z).2 →
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma722Objects.normForm h00 A' D).toFun (D.bijection.toFun p₀) =
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma722Objects.normForm h00 A' D).toFun z)

                      (fun _a =>

                          A'.form.toFun

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredLift.mem_lift_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {T : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Substructure M} {k : ℕ}
  (U : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredRVObject (↑T) (1 + k))
  (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (1 + k) U.object.arity),
  p ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift U.object).carrier ↔
    ∃ (h : p.2 ∈ U.object.domain.carrier), DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = U.object.value ⟨p.2, h⟩ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {T} {k}
    U p =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hu hv =>
          have hd := hu ▸ u.property;
          Exists.intro hd
            (have he := Subtype.ext hu;
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = U.object.value _a) (Eq.symm he)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = _a) hv))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.base_real : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}

  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase { real := S, gamma := ∅ } sn A →
    S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV A
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.base_real : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ}
  {sn : Fin n → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag} {A : Set (Fin n → M)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase { real := S, gamma := ∅ } sn A →
    S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV A :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {n}
    {sn} {A} hA =>
  Exists.casesOn hA fun k h =>
    Exists.casesOn h fun γ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hγ hA =>
        Nat.casesAuxOn (motive := fun a => k = a → S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV A) k
          (fun h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun k =>
              ∀ (γ : Fin k → SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
                (∀ (i : Fin k), γ i ∈ { real := S, gamma := ∅ }.gamma) →
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableWith { real := S, gamma := ∅ }.real γ sn A →
                    S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV A)
              (fun γ hγ hA =>
                have hγ0 := funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i;
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun γ =>
                  (∀ (i : Fin 0), γ i ∈ { real := S, gamma := ∅ }.gamma) →
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableWith { real := S, gamma := ∅ }.real γ sn
                        A →
                      S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV A)
                  (fun hγ hA =>
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver.raw_definable
                      ((SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.with_zero_iff S Fin.elim0 sn A).mp hA))
                  (Eq.symm hγ0) hγ hA)
              (Eq.symm h) γ hγ hA)
          (fun k_1 h =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun k =>
              ∀ (γ : Fin k → SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
                (∀ (i : Fin k), γ i ∈ { real := S, gamma := ∅ }.gamma) →
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableWith { real := S, gamma := ∅ }.real γ sn A →
                    S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV A)
              (fun γ hγ hA => False.elim (hγ 0)) (Eq.symm h) γ hγ hA)
          (Eq.refl k)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw_graph : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {k : ℕ}
  {a b : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart { real := S, gamma := ∅ } k}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Iso a b),
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase { real := S, gamma := ∅ }
    (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.graphOn a.domain (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw F)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {k}
    {a b} F =>
  have he :=
    Set.ext fun w =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔ w ∈ {w | ∃ u, w = DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u)})
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVRealProducts.graphOn_exists a.domain
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw F) w))))
        {
          mp := fun a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun x h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
                Eq.symm right ▸
                  Exists.intro ⟨x, hx⟩
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity x _a =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑⟨x, hx⟩
                                ↑(F.equiv ⟨x, hx⟩))
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw_mem F x hx)))
                      (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity x ↑(F.equiv ⟨x, hx⟩)))),
          mpr := fun a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun u h =>
              Eq.symm h ▸
                Exists.intro ↑u
                  ⟨u.property,
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u) =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity (↑u) _a)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.isoRaw_mem F (↑u) u.property)))
                      (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u)))⟩ };
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase { real := S, gamma := ∅ }
            (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) _a)

    F.graph_definable

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {T : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Substructure M} {n r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) ↑T}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData A),
  (∀ (a : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (t : Fin 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
      {u | (a, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ u ∘ Fin.elim0 = t}.Finite) →
    ∀ (a : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (t : Fin 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
      {u | (a, u) ∈ D.map.image.carrier ∧ u ∘ Fin.elim0 = t}.Finite :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {T}
    {n r} {A} D hFinA a t =>
  have hsub := fun ⦃u⦄ a_1 =>
    And.casesOn a_1 fun hu right =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (a, u) ∈ _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.image_carrier D)) hu)
        fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp he =>
          have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst he;
          have h2 :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a - D.shift (D.core p) = p.1) (Eq.symm h1)))
              (add_sub_cancel_right p.1 (D.shift (D.core p)));
          Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
            (Exists.intro (D.core p)
              (Exists.intro p.2
                ⟨⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, p.2) ∈ A.carrier) h2)) hp, funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩,
                  congrArg Prod.snd he⟩));
  Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_iUnion fun b => Set.Finite.image (fun v => D.tags v b) (hFinA (a - D.shift b) t)) hsub

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.defSet_eq_of_carrier : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M}
  {A A' : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S}, A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.defSet_eq_of_carrier : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M}
  {A A' : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S}, A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {P}
    {A A'} h =>
  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t => A = t → A' = A) A
    (fun carrier definable h_1 =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A} => A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A)
        (fun h =>
          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
            A' = t → A' = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }) A'
            (fun carrier_1 definable_1 h_2 =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A'} =>
                A'.carrier = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier →
                  A' = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                (fun h =>
                  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a t =>
                    { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier = a →
                      h ≍ t →
                        { carrier := carrier_1, definable := definable_1 } =
                          { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                    h
                    (fun h_3 =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun carrier_2 =>
                        ∀ (definable_2 : P.Definable S carrier_2)
                          (h :
                            { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier =
                              { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier),
                          h ≍ Eq.refl { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier →
                            { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 } =
                              { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                        (fun definable_2 h h_4 => Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable_2 }) h_3
                        definable_1 h)
                    (Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier) (HEq.refl h))
                (Eq.symm h_2) h)
            (Eq.refl A'))
        (Eq.symm h_1) h)
    (Eq.refl A)
'DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.defSet_eq_of_carrier' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S : Set M} {r : ℕ}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage E) {z : Fin H.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  (Fin.elim0, z) ∈ H.contracted.carrier → ∃ y, (y, z ∘ H.oldLabels) ∈ E.carrier :=

    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {r} {E} H {z} hz =>
  Exists.casesOn hz fun t ht =>
    Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective H.home.bijective t) fun p hp =>
      have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd ht;
      Exists.intro (↑p).1
        (have hl :=
          funext fun i =>
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑p).2 i) Function.comp_apply))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a (H.oldLabels i) = (↑p).2 i) (Eq.symm h2)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).2 (H.oldLabels i) = (↑p).2 i) (Eq.symm hp))) (H.retained p i)));
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p).1, _a) ∈ E.carrier) hl)) p.property)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r : ℕ}

    (∀ (x : Fin 2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
        (x, u) ∈ X.carrier ↔ (∃ y, (y, u) ∈ X.carrier ∧ y 0 = x 0) ∧ ∃ y, (y, u) ∈ X.carrier ∧ y 1 = x 1) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.ImageProduct D :=

    {X} D hXb hprod =>
  have happ := fun u u' h =>
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u i))
          (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u' i))
        (congrFun h (Fin.natAdd 2 i));
  fun x w =>
  { mp := fun hx => ⟨Exists.intro x ⟨hx, rfl⟩, Exists.intro x ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun left right =>
        Exists.casesOn left fun y h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hy h0 =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun y' h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hy' h1 =>
                Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_image_doublyBounded D hXb y w).mp hy)
                  fun u h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hu right =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                      (y, w) ∈ D.map.image.carrier → (y', w) ∈ D.map.image.carrier → (x, w) ∈ D.map.image.carrier)
                      (fun hy hy' =>
                        Exists.casesOn
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_image_doublyBounded D hXb y'
                                (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u)).mp
                            hy')
                          fun u' h =>
                          And.casesOn h fun hu' hw =>
                            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun u' =>
                              (y', u') ∈ X.carrier →
                                Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u =
                                    Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u' →
                                  (x, Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u) ∈
                                    D.map.image.carrier)
                              (fun hu' hw =>
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_image_doublyBounded D hXb x
                                      (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u)).mpr

                                    ⟨(hprod x u).mpr ⟨Exists.intro y ⟨hu, h0⟩, Exists.intro y' ⟨hu', h1⟩⟩, rfl⟩))
                              (happ u u' hw) hu' hw)
                      (Eq.symm right) hy hy' }

def DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.blockSwap : (m a b : ℕ) → Fin (m + a + b) ≃ Fin (m + b + a) :=
fun m a b =>
  finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans
    ((finSumFinEquiv.symm.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin b))).trans
      ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin a) (Fin b)).trans
        (((Equiv.refl (Fin m)).sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm (Fin a) (Fin b))).trans
          ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin b) (Fin a)).symm.trans
            ((finSumFinEquiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin a))).trans finSumFinEquiv)))))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {q : ℕ} (f : Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M)
  (ν : Fin 2 → Fin q) (l : Fin 0 → Fin q), ∏ i, f (Fin.append ν l i) = f (ν 0) * f (ν 1) :=

    l =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = f (ν 0) * f (ν 1)) (Fin.prod_univ_add fun i => f (Fin.append ν l i))))
    (of_eq_true
      (Eq.trans
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg HMul.hMul
                  (Eq.trans (Finset.prod_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => congrArg f (Fin.append_left ν l x))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.product_of_kind : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
    ∀ {C : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
      {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M}
      {t₁ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M} {k : Fin 3},
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellInput.CellWith C ε t t₁ k →
        k ≠ 2 →
          ∀ (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
            (a, b) ∈ C ↔
              a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first C ∧ b ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second C :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv {C} {ε} {t} {t₁} {k} h hk a b =>
  have hfe := DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.fibres_eq_of_kind hv h hk;
  { mp := fun hab => ⟨Exists.intro (a, b) ⟨hab, rfl⟩, Exists.intro (a, b) ⟨hab, rfl⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      And.casesOn a_1 fun left right =>
        Exists.casesOn left fun w h =>
          Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x => x ∈ C ∧ x.1 = a → (a, b) ∈ C) w
            (fun a' b' h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hab' right_1 =>
                right_1 ▸
                  Exists.casesOn right fun w h =>
                    Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x => x ∈ C ∧ x.2 = b → ((a', b').1, b) ∈ C) w
                      (fun a'' b'' h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun hab'' right =>
                          right ▸
                            have h1 := hab'';
                            have ha' := Exists.intro (a', b') ⟨hab', rfl⟩;
                            have ha'' := Exists.intro (a'', b'') ⟨hab'', rfl⟩;
                            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => b'' ∈ _a) (hfe a'' ha'' a' ha')) h1)
                      h)
            h }

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two : ∀ {k : Fin 3}, k ≠ 2 ↔ k = 0 ∨ k = 1
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two : ∀ {k : Fin 3}, k ≠ 2 ↔ k = 0 ∨ k = 1 :=
fun {k} =>
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      match k, h with
      | 0, x => Or.inl rfl
      | 1, x => Or.inr rfl
      | 2, h => absurd rfl h,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Or.casesOn a (fun h => Eq.symm h ▸ of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true))) fun h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸ of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true)) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]

  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 r) ↑T}
  {e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)} {F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContraction A e}

              (fun _a =>

                  SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues _a)

            (propext Set.mem_preimage)))
        {

              (fun h =>
                Exists.casesOn h fun s h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hk hs =>
                    Exists.intro s ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two.mpr (Or.inl hk), (hinj s).mp hs⟩)
              fun h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun s h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hk hs =>
                  Exists.intro s ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two.mpr (Or.inr hk), (hinj s).mp hs⟩,
          mpr := fun a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun s h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hk hs =>
                Or.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two.mp hk)
                  (fun hk => Or.inl (Exists.intro s ⟨hk, (hinj s).mpr hs⟩)) fun hk =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.vfBounded_of_pullback : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n q r k : ℕ}
  {Z : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (n + 1) k)} {D : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n q)}
  {E : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r)}
  (σ : (Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M)
  (τ : (Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  (∀ p ∈ Z, (Fin.init p.1, σ p.2) ∈ D ∧ (fun x => p.1 (Fin.last n), τ p.2) ∈ E) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFBounded D →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFBounded E → DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFBounded Z :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
    {n q r k} {Z} {D} {E} σ τ hZ hD hE =>
  Exists.casesOn hD fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn hE fun δ hδ =>
      Exists.intro (min γ δ) fun p hp i =>
        Fin.lastCases
          (LE.le.trans
            (have this := min_le_right ↑γ ↑δ;
            this)
            (hδ (fun x => p.1 (Fin.last n), τ p.2) (hZ p hp).right 0))
          (fun j =>
            LE.le.trans
              (have this := min_le_left ↑γ ↑δ;
              this)
              (hγ (Fin.init p.1, σ p.2) (hZ p hp).left j))
          i

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  {E : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r)}

  Exists.casesOn hD fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn hE fun δ hδ =>
      have h1 := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left γ δ);
      have h2 := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right γ δ);
      have h3 := le_max_left γ δ;
      have h4 := le_max_right γ δ;

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n q r k : ℕ}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.radii_of_pullback : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n q r k : ℕ}
  {Z : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (n + 1) k)} {D : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n q)}
  {E : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 r)} (ι : Fin q → Fin k) (κ : Fin r → Fin k)
  (R : (Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → Prop),
  (∀ (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (n + 1) k),
      p ∈ Z ↔ (Fin.init p.1, fun i => p.2 (ι i)) ∈ D ∧ (fun x => p.1 (Fin.last n), fun j => p.2 (κ j)) ∈ E ∧ R p.2) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S D →
      DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S E →
        ∀ (t : Fin k → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
          ∃ α,
            DiamondIntegral.Section6.NamedRadii S t α ∧
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre Z t) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n q r k} {Z} {D} {E} ι κ R hZ hD hE t =>
  Exists.casesOn (hD.radii fun i => t (ι i)) fun αD h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hαD hInvD =>
      Exists.casesOn (hE.radii fun j => t (κ j)) fun αE h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hαE hInvE =>
          Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.snocRadius αD αE)
            ⟨fun i =>
              Fin.lastCases
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        (S ∪ Set.range (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues t)).Definable
                          SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV
                          {z | z 0 ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.gammaPullback {_a}})
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.snocRadius_last αD αE)))
                  (Set.Definable.mono (hαE 0) (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.base_comp_subset t κ)))
                (fun j =>
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>

                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>

                      (hInvD (Fin.init (x, t).1) (Fin.init (y, t).1)

                      (and_congr
                        (hInvE (fun x_1 => (x, t).1 (Fin.last n)) (fun x => (y, t).1 (Fin.last n))

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}

    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) fun i =>

            h ≠ 0 →
              ↑δ < SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue h →
                ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue h <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (a + h)) (F₁ (fun x => (a + h) (Fin.last n)) 0) x -
                        Fin.snoc (Fin.init a) (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0) x -
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) h x))

            have e1 := rfl;

              (id
                (congrArg (LT.lt (↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b))
                  (congrArg (⇑SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)
                    (congr
                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                        (congr
                          (congrArg HSub.hSub (Fin.snoc_last (F₁ (fun x => (a + b) (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init (a + b))))
                          (Fin.snoc_last (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init a))))
                      (Fin.snoc_last (L₁ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init b))))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b <
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                          (F₁ _a 0 - F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0 - L₁ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) 0))
                    e1))
                (if hb0 : b (Fin.last n) = 0 then
                  have hz := funext fun x => hb0;
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (LT.lt (↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b))
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (⇑SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congr
                                (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (congrFun'
                                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                        (congrFun'
                                          (congrArg F₁
                                            (Eq.trans (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd fun x => a (Fin.last n)) hz)
                                              (add_zero fun x => a (Fin.last n))))
                                          0))
                                      (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0))
                                    (sub_self (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0))))
                                (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg (⇑L₁) hz) 0) (congrFun (map_zero L₁) 0)))
                              (sub_self 0)))
                          (map_zero SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom))))
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.value_lt_infinity
                      (mul_ne_zero (SpecialTransformations.Section9.finiteValue_ne_zero ε)
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfTupleValue_ne_zero hb)))
                else
                  have hb1 := fun h => hb0 (congrFun h 0);
                  have hcomp :=
                    Exists.casesOn
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue_eq_component (fun x => b (Fin.last n))
                        Nat.zero_lt_one)
                      fun k hk =>
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b ≤ _a) hk))
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue_le_component b (Fin.last n));
                  LE.le.trans_lt (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hcomp)
                    (hδ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) hb1 (LT.lt.trans_le hbδ hcomp)))))
      (fun j ε =>
        Exists.intro 1 fun b hb x =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (LT.lt (↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b))
                (congrArg (⇑SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)
                  (congr
                    (congrArg HSub.hSub
                      (congr
                        (congrArg HSub.hSub
                          (Fin.snoc_castSucc (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n) + b (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init (a + b)) j))
                        (Fin.snoc_castSucc (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init a) j)))
                    (Fin.snoc_castSucc (L₁ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init b) j)))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b <
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                  (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.hasVFDerivativeAt_block._abel_1_1 j b;
                  this)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b < _a)
                    (map_zero SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)))
                (SpecialTransformations.Section9.value_lt_infinity
                  (mul_ne_zero (SpecialTransformations.Section9.finiteValue_ne_zero ε)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfTupleValue_ne_zero hb))))))
      i

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.pullbackLift_unitDerivative : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  have hp1 := fun h => hp ⟨p.property.left, h⟩;
  Exists.casesOn (H.unitDerivative (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.toFactor p) hp1) fun L₁ h =>
    And.casesOn h fun left hdet =>
      Exists.casesOn left fun F₁ h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left hF₁ =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun ρ₁ hρ₁ =>
            Exists.casesOn (hD.radii (↑p).2) fun αD h =>
              And.casesOn h fun left hInvD =>
                Exists.casesOn (Finite.exists_le αD) fun γ hγ =>
                  Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁)
                    ⟨Exists.intro (fun x => Fin.snoc (Fin.init x) (F₁ (fun x_1 => x (Fin.last n)) 0))

                                (have this := le_max_left ↑ρ₁ ↑γ;
                                this)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.mem_pullbackTarget_contracted : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n q r : ℕ}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (D : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n q) S)
  (π : Fin r → Fin q) (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage E)
  (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (w' : Fin (q + H.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  (x, w') ∈
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast
            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.pullbackTarget D H.target π H.oldLabels)).image.carrier ↔
    (x, fun i => w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier ∧
      (Fin.elim0, fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)) ∈ H.contracted.carrier ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin r), w' (Fin.natAdd q (H.oldLabels i)) = w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity (π i)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n q r} {E} D π H x w' =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun a ha =>
        have h1 :=
          have h := congrArg Prod.fst ha;
          h;
        have h2 :=
          have h := congrArg Prod.snd ha;
          h;
        And.casesOn a.property fun haD right =>
          And.casesOn right fun haT hal =>
            ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, fun i => w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier) (Eq.symm h1)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.init (↑a).1, fun i => _a (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier)
                      (Eq.symm h2)))
                  haD),
              ⟨Exists.intro ⟨(fun x => (↑a).1 (Fin.last n), fun j => (↑a).2 (Fin.natAdd q j)), haT⟩
                  (id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            (Fin.init fun x => (↑a).1 (Fin.last n), fun j => _a (Fin.natAdd q j)) =
                              (Fin.elim0, fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)))
                          h2))
                      (Prod.ext
                        (Subsingleton.elim (Fin.init fun x => (↑a).1 (Fin.last n), fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)).1
                          (Fin.elim0, fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)).1)
                        rfl))),
                fun i =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a (Fin.natAdd q (H.oldLabels i)) = _a (Fin.castAdd H.arity (π i)))
                      (Eq.symm h2)))
                  (hal i)⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hD' right =>
        And.casesOn right fun left hlab =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun b hb =>
            have hb2 :=
              have h := congrArg Prod.snd hb;
              h;
            have hT :=
              have he :=
                Prod.ext
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.fin_one_ext
                    (of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.snoc_last ((↑b).1 0) x)) ((↑b).1 0))
                        (eq_self ((↑b).1 0)))))
                  (Eq.symm hb2);
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ H.target.carrier) he)) b.property;
            Exists.intro
              ⟨(Fin.snoc x ((↑b).1 0), w'),
                ⟨id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, fun i => w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier)
                          (Fin.init_snoc ((↑b).1 0) x)))
                      hD'),
                  ⟨hT, hlab⟩⟩⟩
              (id
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, w') = (x, w')) (Fin.init_snoc ((↑b).1 0) x)))
                  (Eq.refl (x, w')))) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictTarget : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage A)
  (C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S)
  (hC : DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.LabelSaturated C A)
  (z : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M (n + 1) H.arity),
  z ∈ (H.lift.restrict ⋯).image.carrier ↔
    z ∈ H.target.carrier ∧ ∃ p ∈ C.carrier, ∀ (i : Fin r), p.2 i = z.2 (H.oldLabels i) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {n r} {A} H C hC z =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        h ▸
          ⟨(H.lift.toFun ⟨↑p, hC.left p.property⟩).property,
            Exists.intro ↑p ⟨p.property, fun i => Eq.symm (H.retained ⟨↑p, hC.left p.property⟩ i)⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hz right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp hpz =>
            Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective H.home.bijective ⟨z, hz⟩) fun p' hp' =>
              have hlab :=
                funext fun i =>
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑p').2 i) (hpz i)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => z.2 (H.oldLabels i) = _a) (Eq.symm (H.retained p' i))))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => z.2 (H.oldLabels i) = (↑_a).2 (H.oldLabels i)) hp'))
                        (Eq.refl (z.2 (H.oldLabels i)))));
              have hp'C := hC.right p (hC.left hp) (↑p') p'.property hlab hp;
              Exists.intro ⟨↑p', hp'C⟩ (congrArg Subtype.val hp') }

    hΓ {n r} {A} {ω} {e} F C hC hCp C' hC' hC'p hdisj hcover z =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hz hzC =>
        Exists.casesOn
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrderedStandardContractionProgram.surjective F.preparedContraction.data.program
            ⟨z, hz⟩)
          fun y hy =>
          Exists.casesOn
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared F.normalization e ↑y).mp y.property) fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hpA hpy =>

                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictContraction_target h00 hc linear hκ hs

                fun hpC' =>
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictContraction_target h00 hc linear hκ hs hv
                      hsmall hΓ F C' hC' hC'p z).mpr
                  (Exists.intro y
                    ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared_restrict F.normalization e C' hC' hC'p
                            ↑y).mpr
                        (Exists.intro p ⟨hpC', hpy⟩),
                      congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩),

      Exists.casesOn
        ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictContraction_target h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ
              F C' hC' hC'p z).mp

              (F.preparedContraction.data.program.toMap.toFun y).property,
