              ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictContraction_target h00 hc linear hκ hs hv
                    hsmall hΓ F C hC hCp z).mp

                                _a)

                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.OrderedStandardContractionProgram.retained
                                F.preparedContraction.data.program y i))))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg
                              (fun _a =>

                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id

                                (fun _a =>

                                    _a.2 (F.preparedContraction.data.program.oldLabels i))

                            (Eq.refl (z.2 (F.preparedContraction.data.program.oldLabels i))))));

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.prepared_saturated F.normalization e C hC hCp).right

                                  targetBijective := SpecialTransformations.Section5.SpecialBijection.bijective TB,

      have hg :=

          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.lemma_6_9 h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hInvHome hf) hQHome;

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at P.form q))

      have hQConst := fun p q hTags =>

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective P.special h00) p)))

            (congr

                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective P.special h00) x))
              (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map.apply_inverse P.map
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.SpecialCovariantChain.bijective P.special h00) y))
            h;
        have ha :=
          SpecialTransformations.Section9.independent_map_of_finiteFibres hc inv

                  (id

                      hPAt))

            Exists.intro J
              ⟨hGJ, Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue J = ↑_a) hRatio)) hVal⟩;

        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SetBaseMatching.unary_relative_measured_rv_family_prepared_matching_exists_of_support

      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChainStep.mem_lift_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) {k : ℕ}
  (c : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart { real := S, gamma := ∅ } k)
  (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M k c.arity),
  p ∈
      (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvLift
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.toMeasured hc c).object).carrier ↔
    SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues p.2 ∈ c.domain ∧
      SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) =
        c.coordinate (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues p.2) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} hc
    {k} c p =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hu hv =>
          have hd := u.property;
          ⟨Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues _a ∈ c.domain) hu) hd,
            have h1 :=
              Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1) =
                        SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues _a)
                    hv))
                (Eq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1)));
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = c.coordinate (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues p.2)) h1))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.toMeasured hc c).object.value u) =
                        c.coordinate (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues _a))
                    (Eq.symm hu)))
                (Eq.refl
                  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues
                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.MeasuredRVBridge.toMeasured hc c).object.value u))))⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hd hv =>
        Exists.intro ⟨p.2, hd⟩ ⟨rfl, SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues_injective (id (Eq.symm hv))⟩ }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

      {L | (a, L) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap V).image.carrier}.Finite) →

    {T} V h a =>

    (Set.Finite.subset (h a) fun ⦃a_1⦄ a_2 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_2 fun u h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hu right =>
          right ▸ (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.mem_regularize V).mpr (Exists.intro (a, u) ⟨hu, rfl⟩))
    fun ⦃u⦄ a_1 ⦃v⦄ a_2 he =>
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a) u i))
          (Fin.append_right (DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M a) v i))
        (congrFun he (Fin.natAdd n i))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.regularize_snd_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r : ℕ} {p q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r},
  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p).2 = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize q).2 ↔
    DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M q.1 ∧ p.2 = q.2 :=

          have this := congrFun h (Fin.castAdd r i);

          have this := congrFun h (Fin.natAdd n i);
          Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => p.2 i = _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.regularize_snd_right q i))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.reg_rvBounded : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r : ℕ} {T : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Substructure M}
  {X : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) ↑T}
  (g : DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.Good T X),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVSupportDoublyBounded (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X).image.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {T} {X} g =>
  Exists.casesOn g.vfBounded fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn g.rvBounded fun δ hδ =>
      have h1 :=
        have this := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left γ δ);
        this;
      have h2 :=
        have this := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right γ δ);
        this;
      have h3 :=
        have this := le_max_left γ δ;
        this;
      have h4 :=
        have this := le_max_right γ δ;
        this;
      Exists.intro (max γ δ) fun p hp i =>
        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.mem_regularize X).mp hp) fun q h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hq right =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun p =>
              p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X).image.carrier →
                ↑(max γ δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ∧
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (p.2 i) ≤ ↑(max γ δ))
              (fun hp =>
                Fin.addCases
                  (fun i =>
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            ↑(max γ δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ∧
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ≤ ↑(max γ δ))
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.regularize_snd_left q i)))
                      (And.casesOn (hγ q hq i) fun hl hu => ⟨LE.le.trans h1 hl, LE.le.trans hu h3⟩))
                  (fun i =>
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            ↑(max γ δ)⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ∧
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ≤ ↑(max γ δ))
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.regularize_snd_right q i)))
                      (And.casesOn (hδ q hq i) fun hl hu => ⟨LE.le.trans h2 hl, LE.le.trans hu h4⟩))
                  i)
              right hp

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.mem_coordEq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} {i}
    {c} {u} hu =>
  { mp := fun a => And.casesOn a fun he right => congrFun he 0,
    mpr := fun he =>
      ⟨funext fun j =>
          List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
            List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a → Fintype.complete j ≍ x → (u ∘ ![i]) j = ![c] j) (Fintype.complete j)
            (fun as h =>
              List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>

                  ∀ (this : j ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (u ∘ ![i]) j = ![c] j)
                  (fun this tail_eq =>

                      this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                        (u ∘ ![i]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) =
                          ![c] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))
                      (fun h => he) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                  (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete j))
            (fun b {as} a h =>
              List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → (u ∘ ![i]) j = ![c] j)
                  (fun tail_eq =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                      ∀ (a : List.Mem j as),
                        Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                          (u ∘ ![i]) j = ![c] j)
                      (fun a h =>
                        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → (u ∘ ![i]) j = ![c] j) a
                          (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                          (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl [])
                          (HEq.refl a))
                      (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                  (eq_of_heq head_eq))
            (Eq.refl (List.finRange (Nat.succ 0))) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete j)),
        hu⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.balanced_mem_left : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A ε t₁ t₂ →
    ∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      y ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second A →
        ((x, y) ∈ A ↔
          x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A ∧

              DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.sharpSet t₁) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {A} {ε}
    {t₁ t₂} h x y hy =>
  have hinv := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv_mem h hy;
  have hε := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.position_positionInv h hy;
  {
    mp := fun hxy =>
      have hx := Exists.intro (x, y) ⟨hxy, rfl⟩;
      have hmem :=
        ⟨id (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre A x) hε)) hxy), hinv⟩;
      Exists.casesOn
        (Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε y ∈ _a) (h.preimage_eq x hx))
          hmem)
        fun s h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hs hse =>
          ⟨hx,
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x - _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.sharpSet t₁) (Eq.symm hse)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.sharpSet t₁) (sub_sub_cancel x s)))
                hs)⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hx hs =>
        have hmem :=
          Exists.intro (x - DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε y)
            ⟨hs, sub_sub_cancel x (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε y)⟩;
        have h1 :=
          (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε y ∈ _a)
                (Eq.symm (h.preimage_eq x hx)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.paradigm_zero_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A f t₁ t₂ →
    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A).Nonempty →
      (t₁ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M ↔ t₂ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {A} {f}
    {t₁ t₂} h hne =>
  Exists.casesOn hne fun a ha =>
    {
      mp := fun h1 =>
        have hfib := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre_of_zero_left h h1 ha;
        Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_surjective t₂) fun s hs =>
          have hmem := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => s + f a ∈ _a) (h.fibre_eq a ha))) (Exists.intro s ⟨hs, rfl⟩);
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) (Eq.symm hs)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext add_eq_right))
                    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext Set.mem_singleton_iff))
                      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => s + f a ∈ _a) hfib) hmem)))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_zero))
                (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)))),
      mpr := fun h2 =>
        have hfib := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre_of_zero h h2 ha;
        have hpre := h.preimage_eq a ha;
        Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_surjective t₁) fun s hs =>
          have hmem :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => a - s ∈ _a)
                  (Eq.mp
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        f ⁻¹' _a ∩ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A =
                          (fun x => a - x) '' DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.sharpSet t₁)
                      hfib)
                    hpre)))
              (Exists.intro s ⟨hs, rfl⟩);
          have he := h.bijective.right.left hmem.right ha hmem.left;
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) (Eq.symm hs)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)
                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext sub_eq_self)) he)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M) DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_zero))
                (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rvZero M)))) }

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.slope_eq : ∀ {M : Type} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A f t₁ t₂ →
    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A).Nonempty →
      ∀ {s : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M},
        DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.HasSlope (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A) f s →
          ↑s * t₁ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₂
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.slope_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A f t₁ t₂ →
    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A).Nonempty →
      ∀ {s : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M},
        DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.HasSlope (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first A) f s →
          ↑s * t₁ = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₂ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {A} {f}
    {t₁ t₂} h hne {s} hs =>
  Exists.casesOn hne fun a ha =>
    Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_surjective t₂) fun s₂ hs₂ =>
      have hmem := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => s₂ + f a ∈ _a) (h.fibre_eq a ha))) (Exists.intro s₂ ⟨hs₂, rfl⟩);
      Exists.casesOn (h.bijective.right.right (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.mem_second_of_fibre hmem))
        fun a' h_1 =>
        And.casesOn h_1 fun ha' he =>
          have hpre :=
            ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a) (propext Set.mem_preimage)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre A a) he)) hmem),
              ha'⟩;
          Exists.casesOn (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => a' ∈ _a) (h.preimage_eq a ha)) hpre) fun s₁ h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hs₁ hs₁e =>
              have hslope := hs a' ha' a ha;
              have hneg :=
                id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-s₁) = _a)
                        (Eq.symm (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-1) s₁))))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-s₁) =
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom _a)
                          (neg_one_mul s₁)))
                      (Eq.refl (SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-s₁)))));
              have hsq :=
                id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1)
                        (Eq.symm (map_mul SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom (-1) (-1)))))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom _a = 1)
                          (neg_one_mul (-1))))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom _a = 1) (neg_neg 1)))
                        (Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (map_one SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVOperations.rvHom)))
                          (Eq.refl 1)))));
              Trans.trans
                (Trans.trans
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑s * t₁ = _a * (↑s * t₁)) hsq))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑s * t₁ = _a) (one_mul (↑s * t₁)))) (Eq.refl (↑s * t₁))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * (↑s * (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₁)))
                        (mul_assoc (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1)) (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1))
                          (↑s * t₁))))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * _a =
                              DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * (↑s * (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₁)))
                          (mul_left_comm (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1)) (↑s) t₁)))
                      (Eq.refl
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * (↑s * (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₁)))))))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * _a = DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₂)
                      (Eq.symm
                        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => t₂ = ↑s * (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * _a)) hs₁)
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg
                              (fun _a =>
                                _a = ↑s * (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M s₁))
                              hs₂)
                            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M s₂ = ↑s * _a) hneg)
                              (Eq.mp
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M s₂ = ↑s * DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a)
                                  (sub_sub_cancel_left a s₁))
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a =>
                                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M s₂ = ↑s * DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (_a - a))
                                    (Eq.symm hs₁e))
                                  (Eq.mp
                                    (congrArg
                                      (fun _a =>
                                        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = ↑s * DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (a' - a))
                                      (add_sub_cancel_right s₂ (f a)))
                                    (Eq.mp
                                      (congrArg
                                        (fun _a =>
                                          DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (_a - f a) =
                                            ↑s * DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (a' - a))
                                        he)
                                      hslope))))))))))
                  (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (-1) * t₂)))
